Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Aron Baynes?

Aron Baynes is 39 years old.

Where was Aron Baynes born?

Aron Baynes was born in Gisborne, New Zealand.

When was Aron Baynes born?

Aron Baynes was born on December 9, 1986.

How tall is Aron Baynes?

Aron Baynes is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Aron Baynes weigh when playing?

Aron Baynes weighed 260 lbs (117 kg) when playing.

Is Aron Baynes in the Hall of Fame?

Aron Baynes is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Aron Baynes play?

Center.

When did Aron Baynes retire?

Aron Baynes last played in 2021.

What is Aron Baynes' net worth?

Aron Baynes made at least $38,241,922 playing professional basketball.

How much did Aron Baynes make?

Aron Baynes made $7,000,000 in 2021.

What did Aron Baynes average?

Aron Baynes averaged 6.0 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 0.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Aron Baynes have?

Aron Baynes won one championship.

What is Aron Baynes' Instagram account?

Aron Baynes is on Instagram at houseobayne.

What schools did Aron Baynes attend?

Aron Baynes attended Washington State.

What are Aron Baynes' nicknames?

Bangers, Baynesey, Beast, Barbarian, Batman are nicknames for Aron Baynes.
